partnershipPlan: Two parent advisers from the most deprived neighbourhoods and one school nurse review the topic guide and recruitment materials; both campaign groups are told how the study works and invited to comment on the information sheet, not on the guide.
socialListening: Three months of the town's community forum threads on fluoridation, summarised as composite themes without usernames.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I did not know they had stopped it; nobody told us anything.
items.implication: Ask parents what they heard and from whom.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: It should be my choice what goes into my children's water.
items.implication: Treat choice as a value to understand, not a misconception to correct.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Parents ask me why the council did it, and I have ten minutes and no leaflet.
items.implication: Include dental teams as a group with their own questions.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The same people who told us it was safe now say they are only listening.
items.implication: Use interviewers from outside the public health team.

summary: Four composite voices on not knowing, choice, dental teams and distrust.
